messages:
leo: Heads-up — noticed staging ExternalSecret stopped rotating creds for payments-svc around 10:02. Terraform patch earlier changed annotation key. Anyone seen this?

sasha: oof. PR? link?

leo: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4521 — changed annotation from `externalsecret.redwood.io/rotation` to `externalsecret.io/rotation` in module. small snippet:

```hcl
metadata {
  annotations = {
    "externalsecret.io/rotation" = "true"
  }
}
```

tania: The controller watches `externalsecret.redwood.io/rotate` (we standardized keys last year). That mismatch would explain it. Check external-secrets-controller logs for "no rotation annotation".

sasha: checking logs...

`kubectl -n payments logs deploy/external-secrets-controller | grep rotate`

I see repeated "annotation key not present, skipping rotation" entries.

leo: ah ok — should we revert the module or add mapping? prefer a tiny tf patch to map to the redwood key so existing controllers keep working.

tania: small change is fine. Quick patch:

```hcl
annotations = merge(var.annotations, { "externalsecret.redwood.io/rotate" = lookup(var.annotations, "externalsecret.io/rotation", "false") })
```

Then bump module, run `terraform apply` in staging.

sasha: I can cut the PR and run apply in staging, assign to me. I'll also add a test in our k8s module test harness.

ops-bot: CI pipeline triggered for PR #4522 — plan succeeded on staging (no drift).

leo: thanks. after deploy let's watch a couple rotations manually with `kubectl get externalsecret -o yaml` and check `status.lastRotation` timestamps.

tania: for long term, we should add a linter rule forbidding the old key change — it'd catch this in code review.

sasha: noted, adding linter issue to infra backlog #INFRA-128 :thumbsup:

oncall-bot: oncall notified — no pager expected.

leo: great, thanks everyone.
